name: altibooks
description: AltiBooks connects your AI assistant to your company's AltiBooks accounting workspace: contacts, products, quotes, invoices and credit notes, supplier bills, payments and payment links, recurring invoices, receivables, bank balances and transactions, and the questions the Altixia team asks you about your records. Every call runs with your own rights in your own workspace.

capabilities: Price changes, stops and suspensions of recurring invoices
Refunds of card and direct debit payments
Subscriptions taken over from Stripe or Whop
defaultPrompt: Which of my invoices are unpaid, and since when?
What are my bank balances today?
Prepare an invoice for my last customer, same lines as last month.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.10.4: no new tool, and no change to what the existing tools do. Every tool now also carries its display title in its annotations (annotations.title), identical to the title it already had, so that directories and clients that read the name there show it. The titles, descriptions, input schemas and the read-only, destructive and open-world hints are unchanged. The connector announces the same version, 1.10.4. Listing, test cases and commerce declaration: unchanged.

positive.description: Receivables by age: who owes money and which invoices are overdue
positive.prompt: Who owes me money in AltiBooks, and which invoices are overdue?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the customers with open invoices by age bucket, in USD: six customers in the demo workspace, about 592,780 USD in total. The overdue invoices include INV0008ZZ for Bugatti Automobiles S.A.S. (due 2026-09-16), INV0009ZZ for Maserati S.p.A. and INV0010ZZ for Nintendo Co., Ltd. Nothing is changed in the workspace.

positive.description: Read one invoice with its lines
positive.prompt: Show me invoice INV0008ZZ with its lines.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows invoice INV0008ZZ: customer Bugatti Automobiles S.A.S., dated 2026-08-17, due 2026-09-16, one line "Global Launch Experience" (quantity 1, 230,000), total 230,000 EUR, not paid.

positive.description: Find a customer, their contact details and their open invoice
positive.prompt: Find the customer Patek Philippe: what is their email address, and do they have an unpaid invoice?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Patek Philippe SA (Geneva, Switzerland), email contact@patek.example, and its open invoice INV0013ZZ, due 2026-11-18.

positive.description: Quotes sent and waiting for the customer's answer
positive.prompt: Which of my quotes have been sent and are still waiting for the customer's answer?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sent quotes: SO0003ZZ for Apple Inc. (144,000 USD) and SO0002ZZ for Rolls-Royce Motor Cars Ltd (60,000 USD), both valid until 2026-11-21.

positive.description: Prepare a draft quote without sending it
positive.prompt: Create a draft quote for Leica Camera AG for one Strategy Workshop (one day). Don't send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new draft quote for Leica Camera AG with one line "Strategy Workshop (one day)", quantity 1, 9,500 USD, and gives its number. The quote stays a draft: nothing is sent to the customer.

negative.description: Moving money is out of scope
negative.prompt: Transfer 5,000 USD from my Mercury account to Ferrari S.p.A.
negative.expected_behavior: No money is moved and no tool is called to do it: AltiBooks reads bank transactions but cannot make a payment or a transfer. The assistant says so and suggests making the transfer from the bank.

negative.description: A posted invoice cannot be deleted
negative.prompt: Delete invoice INV0008ZZ, Bugatti will never pay it.
negative.expected_behavior: The invoice is not deleted: no tool deletes a posted invoice. The assistant explains that a posted invoice is cancelled with a credit note and asks for confirmation before preparing one.

negative.description: No access to another company's workspace
negative.prompt: Open the AltiBooks workspace of another company, acme, and list its invoices.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant only works in the workspaces opened to the signed-in person (here "Démo Books", as altibooks_whoami shows). It says it has no access to another company's workspace and returns no data from it.

review.commerce_description: AltiBooks sells nothing inside ChatGPT and takes no payment there. For the business's own invoices, it can create a card payment link and set up automatic payment of recurring invoices: the business's customers pay on Stripe's page, outside ChatGPT, and AltiBooks never sees their card details. When the business asks for it, AltiBooks can also refund a payment collected this way, in full or in part, to the card or bank account that paid: the refund is made by the payment provider (Stripe or Whop), outside ChatGPT.
